sections.heading: First: Protect Sleep and Rest
lines: Sleep is a priority because it protects healing, regulation, and the ability to act.
Rest during the day when recovery is the real need; do not fill every open moment.
Night Time Routine is the wind-down sequence. Sleep is the outcome, not another checkbox.

sections.heading: Why
lines: Build a life I can feel and live fully.
Do the work and make space for love.
Create an environment that supports the relationships and experiences I need.

sections.heading: Remember
lines: Nourishing my body supports energy, strength, skin, hair, and mental health.

sections.heading: Grounding Lens
lines: What matters most today?
Practice patience.
Reconnect with purpose and direction.
Make room for joy and curiosity.
Act with self-assurance.

guides.title: Rest & Sleep Priorities

sections.heading: Rest while awake
lines: Pause before filling every open moment. Choose physical or mental rest when recovery is the real need.

sections.heading: Sleep
lines: Protect sleep as a foundation for healing, regulation, energy, and follow-through.

sections.heading: How it appears in TickTick
lines: Daytime Rest / Quiet Reset = awake rest, meditation, or a straightforward low-thinking action.
Night Time Routine = the wind-down sequence.
Medicine and Vitamins = planned sleep supplements when applicable.
Recovery Options — Choose or Skip = stretching/yoga and other recovery tools.

guides.outro: Sleep is an outcome—not a checkbox.
